name: 用 VSCode 打开
author: w1ndys
description: 点一下就用 Visual Studio Code 打开当前项目根：输入框右侧的小按钮，或窗口右下角常驻的角落按钮；也可以敲 /vscode。只在有工作区的对话里出现——临时会话（没有项目根）不显示任何按钮，也不猜目录。
changelog: Release 0.6.0：打开位置只剩一条规则——**只认当前项目根**。拿得到（有工作区的对话）时，两个按钮与 /vscode 命令直接打开它；拿不到（临时会话）时插件整个不出现：不画按钮、不猜目录、不给替代入口。按钮画出来之前先调一次插件主进程的 hasWorkspace 探测（只读一次 pi.workspace.get()），探测为否或探测失败都不画，所以不存在「点一下打开一个猜出来的目录」。上一轮试过两条临时会话的路子，都已撤掉：插件自己拼会话 scratch 会在切换会话后打开别的会话；把 /vscode-here 填进输入框交给宿主的 Agent 扩展，则因为扩展 cwd 是 projectPath 加进程目录的退路、临时会话落到系统根，同样打不开。随之后果：不再声明 agent.extension 权限、不再带 Agent 扩展（它在有工作区的对话里与 /vscode 完全等效，却要一个能在 sidecar 里执行命令的重权限），rendererActions 也收回只剩 plugin.call。Release 0.5.0：新增窗口右下角的常驻按钮（自绘层，官方规格 docs/plugin-plan/ui/self-dialog 的角落浮层做法），点一次就打开；输入框按钮与 /vscode 命令保留，三条入口共用同一条打开路径。Release 0.4.0：输入框右侧新增一个按钮，点一次就打开（renderer.extension）。Release 0.3.0：补齐插件中心要求的 i18n safetyNotes，命令加上关键词与分类；声明 notify 权限用于结果提示。Release 0.2.0：去掉侧边栏页面，改为一条命令立刻打开。Release 0.1.0：首个版本，面板按钮打开当前工作目录。

commands.title: 用 VSCode 打开当前工作目录

safetyNotes: 做一件事：用 Visual Studio Code 打开一个目录。目录只有一条来源，不做推断——按钮与 /vscode 命令读一次 pi.workspace.get() 的当前项目根，取到就直接打开它；取不到就认为本次对话没有工作区（临时会话），此时插件在界面上什么都不显示：输入框按钮与角落按钮都不画，也没有任何替代入口去猜目录。按钮靠 renderer.extension：无构建 ES 模块加载进 PI-Desktop 自己的窗口，只注册一个插槽组件与一个自绘角落按钮；它们只调插件主进程的两个方法——hasWorkspace 探测这次对话有没有工作区，openWorkspace 打开它——不读文件、不拼路径、不枚举目录、不碰剪贴板。角落按钮按官方自绘层规格画在自己申请的零尺寸层里，只在对话界面出现，不遮挡内容。插件不注册 Agent 扩展、不声明 agent.extension：那条路在临时会话里拿不到会话目录，在有工作区的对话里又与 /vscode 完全等效，所以摘掉，插件在 Agent sidecar 内不做任何事。所有入口都由用户主动触发，拉起外部命令后立即返回，不等待编辑器退出。

en.name: Open in VS Code
en.description: Open the open project root in Visual Studio Code with one click: the composer button, the corner button, or the /vscode command. It appears only in conversations that have a workspace; a temporary conversation gets no button at all and nothing is guessed.
en.safetyNotes: Does one thing: opens a directory in Visual Studio Code. The directory has exactly one source, never guessed - the buttons and the /vscode command read the open project root once through pi.workspace.get() and open it directly; when there is none, the conversation is treated as having no workspace (a temporary conversation) and the plugin draws nothing at all: neither the composer button nor the corner button appears, and there is no fallback entry point that would guess a directory. The buttons come from renderer.extension: a build-free ES module loads into PI-Desktop's own window and registers one slot component plus one self-drawn corner button; they call only two methods on the plugin host process - hasWorkspace to detect whether this conversation has a workspace, and openWorkspace to open it - and never read files, compose paths, list directories or touch the clipboard. The corner button follows the official self-drawn layer spec, lives in a zero-sized layer the plugin opens, appears only on the chat surface and never covers content. The plugin registers no Agent extension and declares no agent.extension: that path cannot see the session directory in a temporary conversation, and in a conversation that has a workspace it is equivalent to the /vscode command, so it was removed and the plugin does nothing inside the Agent sidecar. Every entry runs only when the user triggers it and returns immediately without waiting for the editor to exit.
